This report creates the sole stage-specific data entry for Step 4. It preserves
the complete 90-prompt sequence, creates the strict Core, Peripheral, and
Distress means, transforms the three duration variables with `log1p()`, recodes
the three frequency variables from 1--4 to 0--3, and constructs the separately
scaled 30-day aggregation sensitivity data. It estimates no statistical model.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
  collapse = FALSE, comment = NA
)

required_packages <- c("dplyr", "knitr", "rmarkdown", "tibble", "tidyr")
available <- vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
if (!all(available)) {
  stop("Missing required R packages: ", paste(names(available)[!available], collapse = ", "))
}

locate_project_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  candidate <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  if (!dir.exists(candidate)) candidate <- dirname(candidate)
  repeat {
    if (all(dir.exists(file.path(candidate, c(
      "Step_1_Descriptive_and_Reliability", "Step_4_Dynamic_Structural_Equation_Modeling"
    ))))) return(candidate)
    parent <- dirname(candidate)
    if (identical(parent, candidate)) break
    candidate <- parent
  }
  stop("Could not identify the project root from the public Step folders")
}

load_single_object <- function(path, expected_name) {
  environment <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
  loaded <- load(path, envir = environment)
  if (!identical(loaded, expected_name)) {
    stop("Expected only ", expected_name, "; found: ", paste(loaded, collapse = ", "))
  }
  environment[[expected_name]]
}

strict_complete_mean <- function(data, variables) {
  values <- as.data.frame(lapply(data[variables], as.numeric))
  complete <- rowSums(!is.na(values)) == length(variables)
  score <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(values))
  score[complete] <- rowMeans(values[complete, , drop = FALSE])
  score
}

safe_mean <- function(x) if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)

within_scaling_row <- function(data, variable, mode, level) {
  person_mean <- ave(
    data[[variable]], data[["Name_ID"]],
    FUN = function(x) if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  within_value <- data[[variable]] - person_mean
  person_values <- tapply(data[[variable]], data[["Name_ID"]], safe_mean)
  data.frame(
    level = level,
    mode = mode,
    variable = variable,
    transformation = "log1p duration",
    n_observed = as.integer(sum(!is.na(data[[variable]]))),
    participants = as.integer(length(unique(data[["Name_ID"]][!is.na(data[[variable]])]))),
    within_sd = stats::sd(within_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_sd = stats::sd(data[[variable]], na.rm = TRUE),
    between_sd_person_means = stats::sd(person_values, na.rm = TRUE),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

input_context <- knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)
project_start <- if (length(input_context) == 1L && !is.na(input_context) &&
                     nzchar(input_context)) input_context else getwd()
project_root <- locate_project_root(project_start)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = project_root)

input_file <- file.path(
  project_root, "Res_2_Data_for_Analysis", "dat_focal_analysis.rda"
)
output_file <- file.path(
  project_root, "Res_2_Data_for_Analysis", "dat_step4_dsem.rda"
)
stopifnot(file.exists(input_file))
dir.create(dirname(output_file), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# Load and audit the canonical source

```{r load-source}
dat_focal_analysis <- load_single_object(input_file, "dat_focal_analysis")

peripheral_items <- c("PMU1", "PMU2")
core_items <- paste0("PMU", 3:6)
distress_items <- paste0("DASS", 1:6)
duration_source <- paste0("mu_time", 1:3)
frequency_source <- paste0("mu_frequency", 1:3)
required_source <- c(
  "Data_ID", "Name_ID", "Day", "Time",
  peripheral_items, core_items, distress_items,
  duration_source, frequency_source
)

stopifnot(
  all(required_source %in% names(dat_focal_analysis)),
  nrow(dat_focal_analysis) == 18810L,
  dplyr::n_distinct(dat_focal_analysis[["Name_ID"]]) == 209L,
  !anyNA(dat_focal_analysis[c("Name_ID", "Day", "Time")]),
  !anyDuplicated(dat_focal_analysis[c("Name_ID", "Day", "Time")]),
  identical(sort(unique(dat_focal_analysis[["Day"]])), 1:30),
  identical(sort(unique(dat_focal_analysis[["Time"]])), 1:3)
)

source_audit <- data.frame(
  check = c(
    "Scheduled prompt rows", "Participants", "Days per participant",
    "Prompts per participant", "Duplicate prompt keys"
  ),
  value = c(
    nrow(dat_focal_analysis),
    dplyr::n_distinct(dat_focal_analysis[["Name_ID"]]),
    min(tapply(dat_focal_analysis[["Day"]], dat_focal_analysis[["Name_ID"]], dplyr::n_distinct)),
    min(table(dat_focal_analysis[["Name_ID"]])),
    sum(duplicated(dat_focal_analysis[c("Name_ID", "Day", "Time")]))
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
knitr::kable(source_audit)
```

# Prompt-level DSEM data

```{r prepare-prompt}
prompt <- dat_focal_analysis |>
  dplyr::arrange(Name_ID, Day, Time) |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    Data_ID = as.numeric(Data_ID),
    Name_ID = as.numeric(Name_ID),
    Day = as.integer(Day),
    Time = as.integer(Time),
    tprompt = as.integer(3L * (Day - 1L) + Time),
    dayc = as.numeric(Day - 15.5),
    tm2 = as.integer(Time == 2L),
    tm3 = as.integer(Time == 3L),
    InteractiveMinutes = as.numeric(mu_time1),
    ActiveMinutes = as.numeric(mu_time2),
    PassiveMinutes = as.numeric(mu_time3),
    InteractiveLog = log1p(InteractiveMinutes),
    ActiveLog = log1p(ActiveMinutes),
    PassiveLog = log1p(PassiveMinutes),
    InteractiveFrequency = as.numeric(mu_frequency1) - 1,
    ActiveFrequency = as.numeric(mu_frequency2) - 1,
    PassiveFrequency = as.numeric(mu_frequency3) - 1,
    Peripheral = strict_complete_mean(
      dplyr::pick(dplyr::all_of(peripheral_items)), peripheral_items
    ),
    Core = strict_complete_mean(
      dplyr::pick(dplyr::all_of(core_items)), core_items
    ),
    Distress = strict_complete_mean(
      dplyr::pick(dplyr::all_of(distress_items)), distress_items
    )
  ) |>
  as.data.frame()

sequence_audit <- prompt |>
  dplyr::group_by(Name_ID) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    rows = dplyr::n(), min_tprompt = min(tprompt), max_tprompt = max(tprompt),
    exact_sequence = identical(tprompt, 1:90), .groups = "drop"
  )

score_variables <- c(
  "InteractiveLog", "ActiveLog", "PassiveLog",
  "InteractiveFrequency", "ActiveFrequency", "PassiveFrequency",
  "Core", "Peripheral", "Distress"
)
prompt_completeness <- data.frame(
  level = "Prompt",
  variable = score_variables,
  observed = vapply(prompt[score_variables], function(x) sum(!is.na(x)), integer(1)),
  missing = vapply(prompt[score_variables], function(x) sum(is.na(x)), integer(1)),
  minimum = vapply(prompt[score_variables], function(x) min(x, na.rm = TRUE), numeric(1)),
  maximum = vapply(prompt[score_variables], function(x) max(x, na.rm = TRUE), numeric(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

stopifnot(
  nrow(prompt) == 18810L,
  nrow(sequence_audit) == 209L,
  all(sequence_audit$rows == 90L),
  all(sequence_audit$min_tprompt == 1L),
  all(sequence_audit$max_tprompt == 90L),
  all(sequence_audit$exact_sequence),
  all(prompt_completeness$minimum >= 0),
  all(prompt_completeness$maximum[
    prompt_completeness$variable %in% c("Core", "Peripheral", "Distress")
  ] <= 5),
  all(prompt_completeness$maximum[
    grepl("Frequency", prompt_completeness$variable)
  ] <= 3)
)

knitr::kable(prompt_completeness, digits = 4)
```

# Strict 30-day aggregation sensitivity data

```{r prepare-daily}
daily <- prompt |>
  dplyr::group_by(Name_ID, Day) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_scheduled = dplyr::n(),
    InteractiveMinutes = if (sum(!is.na(InteractiveMinutes)) == 3L) {
      sum(InteractiveMinutes)
    } else NA_real_,
    ActiveMinutes = if (sum(!is.na(ActiveMinutes)) == 3L) {
      sum(ActiveMinutes)
    } else NA_real_,
    PassiveMinutes = if (sum(!is.na(PassiveMinutes)) == 3L) {
      sum(PassiveMinutes)
    } else NA_real_,
    Core = if (sum(!is.na(Core)) == 3L) mean(Core) else NA_real_,
    Peripheral = if (sum(!is.na(Peripheral)) == 3L) mean(Peripheral) else NA_real_,
    Distress = if (sum(!is.na(Distress)) == 3L) mean(Distress) else NA_real_,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    tday = as.integer(Day),
    dayc = as.numeric(Day - 15.5),
    InteractiveLog = log1p(InteractiveMinutes),
    ActiveLog = log1p(ActiveMinutes),
    PassiveLog = log1p(PassiveMinutes)
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(Name_ID, Day) |>
  dplyr::select(
    Name_ID, Day, tday, dayc, n_scheduled,
    InteractiveMinutes, ActiveMinutes, PassiveMinutes,
    InteractiveLog, ActiveLog, PassiveLog,
    Core, Peripheral, Distress
  ) |>
  as.data.frame()

daily_sequence_audit <- daily |>
  dplyr::group_by(Name_ID) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    rows = dplyr::n(), min_tday = min(tday), max_tday = max(tday),
    exact_sequence = identical(tday, 1:30), .groups = "drop"
  )

daily_variables <- c(
  "InteractiveLog", "ActiveLog", "PassiveLog", "Core", "Peripheral", "Distress"
)
daily_completeness <- data.frame(
  level = "Daily",
  variable = daily_variables,
  observed = vapply(daily[daily_variables], function(x) sum(!is.na(x)), integer(1)),
  missing = vapply(daily[daily_variables], function(x) sum(is.na(x)), integer(1)),
  minimum = vapply(daily[daily_variables], function(x) min(x, na.rm = TRUE), numeric(1)),
  maximum = vapply(daily[daily_variables], function(x) max(x, na.rm = TRUE), numeric(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

stopifnot(
  nrow(daily) == 6270L,
  all(daily$n_scheduled == 3L),
  nrow(daily_sequence_audit) == 209L,
  all(daily_sequence_audit$rows == 30L),
  all(daily_sequence_audit$exact_sequence),
  all(daily_completeness$observed > 0L)
)

knitr::kable(daily_completeness, digits = 4)
```

# Separate prompt and daily scaling constants

```{r scaling-audit}
mode_map <- c(
  InteractiveLog = "Interactive/message",
  ActiveLog = "Active/posting",
  PassiveLog = "Passive/browsing"
)
scaling <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(names(mode_map), function(variable) {
    within_scaling_row(prompt, variable, mode_map[[variable]], "Prompt")
  }),
  lapply(names(mode_map), function(variable) {
    within_scaling_row(daily, variable, mode_map[[variable]], "Daily")
  })
)

prompt_targets <- c(
  InteractiveLog = 0.822181,
  ActiveLog = 0.756508,
  PassiveLog = 0.988582
)
prompt_scaling <- scaling[scaling$level == "Prompt", ]
target_difference <- prompt_scaling$within_sd - prompt_targets[prompt_scaling$variable]
stopifnot(
  all(is.finite(scaling$within_sd)),
  all(scaling$within_sd > 0),
  all(scaling$participants == 209L),
  max(abs(target_difference)) < 0.000001
)

knitr::kable(scaling, digits = 6)
```

# Variable map, provenance, and saved object

```{r save-object}
variable_map <- data.frame(
  source = c(
    duration_source, frequency_source,
    paste(peripheral_items, collapse = ", "),
    paste(core_items, collapse = ", "),
    paste(distress_items, collapse = ", ")
  ),
  prompt_variable = c(
    "InteractiveLog", "ActiveLog", "PassiveLog",
    "InteractiveFrequency", "ActiveFrequency", "PassiveFrequency",
    "Peripheral", "Core", "Distress"
  ),
  role = c(
    rep("Primary duration", 3), rep("Frequency sensitivity", 3),
    "Mediator", "Mediator", "Outcome"
  ),
  scoring = c(
    rep("log1p(raw prompt minutes)", 3),
    rep("raw category minus 1", 3),
    "Strict 2/2 mean", "Strict 4/4 mean", "Strict 6/6 mean"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

lag_audit <- data.frame(
  interval = c("Lag-1 within-day", "Lag-1 overnight", "Lag-2 same-day", "Lag-2 crosses overnight"),
  scheduled_per_person = c(60L, 29L, 30L, 58L),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

dat_step4_dsem <- list(
  prompt = prompt,
  daily = daily,
  variable_map = variable_map,
  scaling = scaling,
  audit = list(
    source = source_audit,
    prompt_completeness = prompt_completeness,
    daily_completeness = daily_completeness,
    prompt_sequence = sequence_audit,
    daily_sequence = daily_sequence_audit,
    lag_structure = lag_audit
  ),
  provenance = list(
    generated_by = paste0(
      "Step_4_Dynamic_Structural_Equation_Modeling/",
      "S4_1_PrepareDSEMData.Rmd"
    ),
    generated_at = format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %z"),
    source_file = "Res_2_Data_for_Analysis/dat_focal_analysis.rda",
    source_md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(input_file)),
    scoring = "Strict-complete unit-weighted prompt means",
    prompt_time_index = "tprompt = 3 * (Day - 1) + Time",
    daily_time_index = "tday = Day",
    frequency_recode = "1-4 recoded to 0-3",
    duration_transform = "log1p",
    within_sd_rule = "sd(person-centered values, na.rm = TRUE; N-1 denominator)"
  )
)

expected_components <- c("prompt", "daily", "variable_map", "scaling", "audit", "provenance")
stopifnot(
  identical(names(dat_step4_dsem), expected_components),
  nrow(dat_step4_dsem$prompt) == 18810L,
  nrow(dat_step4_dsem$daily) == 6270L
)

save(dat_step4_dsem, file = output_file, compress = "xz", version = 3)
verified <- load_single_object(output_file, "dat_step4_dsem")
stopifnot(
  identical(names(verified), expected_components),
  identical(verified$scaling, scaling),
  identical(verified$provenance$source_md5, unname(tools::md5sum(input_file))),
  nrow(verified$prompt) == 18810L,
  nrow(verified$daily) == 6270L
)
```

```{r final-acceptance, include=FALSE}
acceptance <- data.frame(
  gate = c(
    "Canonical source validated",
    "Prompt scaffold and tprompt validated",
    "Strict construct scores validated",
    "Frequency recode validated",
    "Daily scaffold and tday validated",
    "Prompt scaling reproduces targets",
    "Daily scaling independently calculated",
    "Saved RDA reloaded successfully"
  ),
  passed = c(
    nrow(dat_focal_analysis) == 18810L,
    nrow(prompt) == 18810L && all(sequence_audit$exact_sequence),
    all(prompt_completeness$maximum[
      prompt_completeness$variable %in% c("Core", "Peripheral", "Distress")
    ] <= 5),
    all(prompt_completeness$minimum[grepl("Frequency", prompt_completeness$variable)] >= 0) &&
      all(prompt_completeness$maximum[grepl("Frequency", prompt_completeness$variable)] <= 3),
    nrow(daily) == 6270L && all(daily_sequence_audit$exact_sequence),
    max(abs(target_difference)) < 0.000001,
    all(scaling$within_sd[scaling$level == "Daily"] > 0),
    file.exists(output_file) && nrow(verified$prompt) == 18810L
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
stopifnot(all(acceptance$passed))
knitr::kable(acceptance)
```

The canonical Step 4 data object was written to
`Res_2_Data_for_Analysis/dat_step4_dsem.rda`. Downstream Step 4 scripts must
load this object and must not independently rescore items or return to raw SAV
files.
